note: Ps51 Miserere (corrected method; densest IB psalm). 37 chars = the penitent's whole inner drama: confession (pesha x2, avon x3, chatta-family, chata, evil), longing for cleansing/purity (taher x2, clean-heart), broken-contrite heart (dakah x2, broken spirit), clean heart + right/willing spirit renewed (bara/chadash), restored joy (sason x2, simchah, gil), truth in inward being + wisdom, resolve to teach transgressors, praise. God-qualifiers=15 (chesed/racham/chanan mercies appealed to, God justified when he judges, his Holy Spirit sustaining the human spirit, his salvation=joy's source, his not-despising the contrite). v18-19 cultic/communal coda=standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: appealed against God's steadfast love and abundant mercy (v1)

'according to your abundant mercy blot out my TRANSGRESSIONS (pesha)' — the psalm's opening: the penitent owns his rebellion and pleads it erased; pesha (rebellion, the willful breach) the first of the sin-triad (pesha/avon/chatta't) David lays before God, appealing only to divine mercy
the deep-rooted guilt named again (v5, v9)

'Wash me thoroughly from my INIQUITY (avon)' — the crookedness/guilt the penitent begs cleansed; avon (the second of the triad, recurs v5 'brought forth in iniquity', v9) the ingrained perversity, deeper than a single act — needing washing, not mere pardon
cleanse / purify (taher - cleanse me from sin)
long for / plead to be cleansed
the purity-longing renewed (v7 'I shall be clean')

'and CLEANSE (taher) me from my sin!' — the penitent's longing for inner purity; taher (the cultic clean/unclean verb, recurs v7 'wash me and I shall be clean', and the clean heart v10) the deep desire not merely to be pardoned but made pure — the Miserere's driving hunger
the third of the sin-triad, ever before him (v3)

'cleanse me from my SIN (chatta't)!' — the missing-of-the-mark completing the triad (pesha/avon/chatta't); the concrete failure the penitent names, which he says 'is ever before me' (v3) — sin held constantly in view, not suppressed
know / acknowledge (yada - I know my transgressions)
paired with sin ever before him

'For I KNOW (yada) my transgressions, and my sin is ever before me' — the self-knowledge of guilt, true confession; yada here the penitent's unflinching acknowledgment (contrast the wicked's forgetting, Ps50:22) — sin owned and held in view, the ground of genuine repentance
'For I know my TRANSGRESSIONS (pesha)' — the rebellion the penitent acknowledges (echoing v1); pesha owned in the light of self-knowledge, no longer hidden but confessed
sin (chatta't - my sin is ever before me)
'and my SIN (chatta't) is ever before me' — sin kept constantly in view, not repressed; the mark of true contrition — the penitent cannot look away from his failure
sin (chata - against you only have I sinned)
paired with 'done what is evil in your sight'
confessed so that God is shown justified when he judges (v4)

'Against you, you only, have I SINNED (chata) and done what is evil in your sight' — the vertical reckoning of sin: though David wronged Bathsheba and Uriah, all sin is ultimately against God; chata (the act of missing the mark) confessed so that God is justified in his verdict (v4b = the qualifier)
evil (ra - done what is evil in your sight)
paired with 'against you only have I sinned'

'and done what is EVIL (ra) in your sight' — the deed judged evil by God's own eyes; ra here the wrong measured not by human opinion but before God, the standard against which the penitent condemns himself
be brought forth / born (chul - in iniquity)
paired with 'in sin did my mother conceive me'

'Behold, I was BROUGHT FORTH (chul) in iniquity' — the confession of innate, lifelong sinfulness; chul (to be born/writhed forth) the recognition that guilt is not merely an episode but the human condition from the womb — the deepest layer of the penitent's self-knowledge
the avon of v2, now traced to birth
'I was brought forth in INIQUITY (avon)' — the guilt of v2 now traced to its origin; avon shown as native, not acquired — the ground of the plea for a created clean heart (v10)
sin (chet - in sin did my mother conceive me)

'and in SIN (chet) did my mother conceive me' — sinfulness reaching back to conception; chet here the inborn bent, completing the confession of native corruption that makes the plea for re-creation (v10) necessary
truth / faithfulness (emeth - in the inward being)
paired with wisdom taught in the secret heart

'Behold, you delight in TRUTH (emeth) in the inward being' — the integrity God desires deep within; emeth here inner truthfulness, not outward conformity — the honesty of the hidden self (tuchoth), what God's delight (the qualifier) seeks, answered by wisdom taught in the secret heart
the inward being itself (the hidden self)
the locus where God desires truth

'you delight in truth in the INWARD BEING (tuchoth)' — the hidden depths of the self; tuchoth the innermost parts (paralleled by 'the secret heart'), the seat where God looks for truth and teaches wisdom — the very core the penitence must reach
make known / teach (yada hiphil - teach me wisdom)
paired with truth in the inward being

'and you TEACH (yada) me wisdom in the secret heart' — the inner instruction the penitent receives; the hidden self opened to God's teaching, wisdom implanted where he desires truth — knowledge not of facts but of the reordered inner life
wisdom (chokmah - taught in the secret heart)
the object of God's inner teaching

'you teach me WISDOM (chokmah) in the secret heart' — the wisdom God implants in the hidden self; chokmah here not the sage's craft but the reordering of the inner life toward truth — the fruit of God's teaching in the depths
purge / un-sin (chata piel - Purge me with hyssop)
paired with 'I shall be clean' / whiter than snow

'PURGE (chata piel — de-sin) me with hyssop, and I shall be clean' — the plea for ritual-deep purification; chata in its privative sense (to remove sin), the penitent longing to be un-sinned, washed 'whiter than snow' — the purity-hunger of v2 renewed
be clean / pure (taher - I shall be clean)
the cleansing longed for in v2

'wash me, and I shall be CLEAN (taher), whiter than snow' — the purity that answers the plea; taher the cleansed state the penitent craves, purity beyond the whiteness of snow — the goal toward which the created clean heart (v10) reaches
hear (shama - let me hear joy and gladness)
paired with the broken bones rejoicing

'Let me HEAR (shama) joy and gladness' — the longing for restored gladness after crushing; shama here the plea to be told the word of pardon that brings back joy, so the bones God broke may rejoice — sorrow turning toward hope
paired with gladness; longed for again (v12)
'Let me hear JOY (sason) and gladness' — the exultation the penitent begs restored; sason (recurs v12 'joy of your salvation') the deep gladness lost in guilt, sought again from the God who pardons
'let me hear joy and GLADNESS (simchah)' — the gladness twinned with sason; simchah the rejoicing the crushed spirit longs to feel again, the emotional restoration that pardon brings
rejoice / spin with joy (gil - the bones may rejoice)
paired with hearing joy and gladness
the bones God himself had broken (chastening) may now exult (v8)

'let the bones that you have broken REJOICE (gil)' — joy reaching the very frame God had crushed; gil (spinning joy) the exultation the penitent asks even of his broken bones — the God who wounded (the qualifier) is the one who can make them dance again
sins (chet - hide your face from my)
paired with 'blot out all my iniquities'

'Hide your face from my SINS (chet)' — the plea that God look away from his failures; chet here the sins the penitent begs God not to gaze upon, twinned with the blotting of all iniquities — pardon as both un-seeing and erasing
the avon of v2, v5 — now 'all' erased

'and blot out all my INIQUITIES (avon)' — the total erasure sought; avon 'all' of it, the ingrained guilt of v2/v5 pleaded wiped away completely — the negative counterpart to the created clean heart that follows (v10)
clean / pure (tahor - create in me a clean heart)
paired with the renewed right spirit

'CREATE in me a CLEAN (tahor) heart, O God' — the psalm's turning-point: not repair but new creation; tahor the purity of v2/v7 now sought at the source — a heart made new by the same bara that made the world, because native iniquity (v5) cannot be merely washed but must be re-created
the seat God is asked to re-create clean

'create in me a clean HEART (leb)' — the inner core to be made new; leb the seat of will/thought/affection, the whole inner self the penitent asks God to re-create pure (contrast the contrite heart, v17)
renew / make new (chadash - a right spirit)
paired with the created clean heart

'and RENEW (chadash) a right spirit within me' — the inner disposition made new and firm; chadash the renewal twinned with creation (bara) — a steadfast spirit set right within, the will re-established toward God after collapse
the willing spirit sought (v12); distinct from the broken spirit (v17)
sustained by God's own Holy Spirit not taken away (v11)

'renew a right SPIRIT (ruach) within me' — the steadfast inner disposition; ruach here the human spirit set firm/right (nakon), first of three spirit-states in the psalm (right v10, willing v12, broken v17), sustained by God's Holy Spirit (v11 = the qualifier) not being withdrawn
the joy first begged in v8; paired with the willing spirit
the joy OF God's salvation (God's saving = its source)

'Restore to me the JOY (sason) of your salvation' — the gladness of being saved, sought back; sason (echoing v8) the exultation that flows from God's deliverance (the qualifier) — not merely emotion but the joy proper to the rescued, upheld by a willing spirit
willing / free / noble (nadib - uphold me with a willing spirit)
paired with the restored joy of salvation

'and uphold me with a WILLING (nadib) spirit' — the free, generous, ready inner disposition; nadib (willing/noble, the root of freewill offerings) the spirit that gladly obeys, not grudging — the settled readiness that upholds the pardoned, second of the three spirit-states
the right spirit of v10, now as willing

'uphold me with a willing SPIRIT (ruach)' — the human spirit characterised as free/willing; ruach the inner disposition (cf right spirit v10, broken spirit v17) that, made generous, sustains obedience — the pardoned life held up from within
transgressors / rebels (pasha - teach transgressors your ways)
paired with sinners returning to God

'Then I will teach TRANSGRESSORS (pasha) your ways' — the pardoned penitent's resolve to help fellow rebels; the fruit of forgiveness turning outward — the one who knew his own pesha (v1,3) now teaches other transgressors God's ways, that sinners may return
sinners (chatta - sinners will return to you)
the fruit of teaching transgressors God's ways

'and SINNERS (chatta) will return to you' — the repentance the penitent's testimony produces; chatta here the sinners who turn back (shub) to God — the pardoned life bearing fruit in others' return, penitence become mission
praise (tehillah - my mouth will declare your praise)
prompted by God's deliverance, salvation and righteousness (v14)

'O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your PRAISE (tehillah)' — the pardoned tongue set free to worship; tehillah the praise that answers deliverance from bloodguilt, God's salvation and righteousness (v14 = the qualifiers) — lips that can only praise once God opens them
paired with the broken and contrite heart

'The sacrifices of God are a BROKEN SPIRIT (ruach nishbarah)' — the offering God truly wants; ruach here shattered, the third and climactic spirit-state (right v10, willing v12, broken v17) — the humbled disposition that is itself the acceptable sacrifice, worth more than bulls (contrast Ps50:13)
crushed / contrite (dakah - a broken and contrite heart)
such a heart God will not despise (v17)

'a broken and CONTRITE (dakah) heart, O God, you will not despise' — the crushed heart God receives; dakah (crushed to dust, cf the bones broken v8) the shattered inner core that, far from being spurned, is precisely what God will not despise (the qualifier) — brokenness as the one acceptable approach
the clean heart God is asked to create (v10) — now the contrite heart he accepts

'a broken and contrite HEART (leb)' — the inner core, now crushed; leb here the same seat asked to be re-created clean (v10), presented in its brokenness as the sacrifice God will not despise — the two poles of the heart in one psalm
sing aloud / ring out (ranan - of your righteousness)
twinned with the mouth declaring God's praise

'my tongue will SING ALOUD (ranan) of your righteousness' — the pardoned tongue ringing out God's justice; ranan (jubilant cry) the exultant praise that answers deliverance from bloodguilt, twin of the mouth declaring praise (v15) — worship freed by forgiveness
declare / tell (nagad - my mouth will declare your praise)
declares the praise (279687); twin of singing aloud (v14)

'and my mouth will DECLARE (nagad) your praise' — the act of the freed mouth; nagad the telling-forth of God's praise, possible only once God opens the lips (v15a) — the outward voicing of the renewed inner life
qualifies the spirit that is God's true sacrifice

'The sacrifices of God are a BROKEN (shabar) spirit' — the shattering that makes the spirit acceptable; shabar here the breaking-force on the inner disposition, the crushed condition (paralleling the bones broken v8) that God receives as offering
broken (shabar - a broken and contrite heart)
paired with 'contrite' as the state of the accepted heart

'a BROKEN (shabar) and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise' — the breaking that, with contrition, God will not spurn; shabar here the heart shattered — twinned with dakah (crushed) — the one approach the holy God receives
hide (sathar - hide your face from my sins)
God's hiding his face from the penitent's sins (v9)

v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'HIDE (sathar) your face from my sins' - God's turning his gaze away is not a human IB char; the divine act the penitent pleads over his sins (279780), twinned with blotting all iniquities. Qualifier.
be pleased / accept (ratsah - not pleased with burnt offering)
God's non-pleasure in sacrifice, pointing to the contrite heart (v16->v17)

v16 QUALIFIER (God's regard, negated): 'you will not be PLEASED (ratsah) with a burnt offering' - God's (non-)acceptance is not a human IB char; the divine preference that turns from cultic offering to the contrite heart (279701) as the true sacrifice. Qualifier.
secret / hidden place (sathum - wisdom in the secret heart)

v6: 'you teach me wisdom in the SECRET HEART (the hidden place)' - the locus of God's inner teaching, parallel to 'the inward being'; a seat/place-term whose content is carried by the truth/wisdom chars (279758/279760/279762). Standalone (locus).
good pleasure / favour (ratson - in your good pleasure)

v18 (cultic/communal coda): 'Do good to Zion in your GOOD PLEASURE (ratson); build up the walls of Jerusalem' - God's favour toward the city, part of the communal-liturgical ending with no individual IB char. Standalone.
be gracious (chanan - have mercy on me)
God's grace appealed to for the blotting of transgression (v1)

v1 QUALIFIER (God's grace): 'Have MERCY (chanan) on me, O God' - God's graciousness is not a human IB char; the divine favour the penitent appeals to as ground for blotting his transgression (279643). Qualifier.
God's covenant love, the measure of the pardon sought (v1)

v1 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'according to your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)' - God's covenant loyalty is not a human IB char; the divine attribute 'according to' which the penitent asks his transgression blotted (279643). Qualifier.
God's abundant mercies, the ground of blotting transgression (v1)

v1 QUALIFIER (God's racham): 'according to your abundant COMPASSION (racham)' - God's womb-deep mercies are not a human IB char; the divine tenderness 'according to' which transgression is blotted (279643). Qualifier.
be justified / in the right (tsadeq - that you may be justified)
God shown righteous in his verdict by the penitent's confession (v4)

v4 QUALIFIER (God in the right): 'so that you may be JUSTIFIED (tsadeq) in your words' - God's being vindicated when he speaks/judges is not a human IB char; the end the confession serves (279738). Qualifier.
be clear / blameless (zakah - blameless in your judgment)
God shown clear/blameless in judging, by the confession (v4)

v4 QUALIFIER (God clear when he judges): 'and BLAMELESS (zakah) in your judgment' - God's being pure/vindicated in his verdict is not a human IB char; twinned with 'justified', the vindication the penitent's confession upholds (279738). Qualifier.
delight / desire (chaphets - you delight in truth)
God's delight seeks truth in the inward being (v6)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's desire): 'you DELIGHT (chaphets) in truth in the inward being' - God's delight is not a human IB char; the divine desire that seeks inner truthfulness (279758), grounding the penitent's plea for a truthful/wise heart. Qualifier.
crush / break (dakah - the bones you have broken)
God's chastening breaking of the bones, now to rejoice (v8)

v8 QUALIFIER (God's chastening act): 'the bones that you have BROKEN (dakah)' - God's crushing of the penitent under conviction is not a human IB char; the divine wounding whose reversal the penitent asks, so the bones may rejoice (279776). Qualifier.
God's holiness qualifying the Spirit that sustains the human spirit (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's holiness): 'take not your HOLY (qodesh) Spirit from me' - the holiness of God's own Spirit is not a human IB char; it qualifies the divine Spirit whose presence upholds the penitent's renewed spirit (279650). Qualifier.
God's own Spirit, sustaining the renewed human spirit (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's Spirit): 'take not your Holy SPIRIT (ruach) from me' - God's own Spirit is not a human IB char (distinct from the human ruach of v10/12/17); the divine presence the penitent begs not withdrawn, source of his renewed right spirit (279650). Qualifier.
salvation (yesha - the joy of your salvation)
God's saving is the source of the restored joy (v12)
v12 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'Restore to me the joy of your SALVATION (yesha)' - God's saving is not a human IB char; the deliverance whose joy the penitent asks restored (279662). Qualifier.
God's deliverance from bloodguilt, prompting praise (v14->v15)

v14 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'DELIVER (natsal) me from bloodguiltiness, O God' - God's rescue is not a human IB char; the deliverance the penitent pleads, which frees his tongue to praise (279687). Qualifier.
God as the penitent's salvation, ground of his praise (v14->v15)
v14 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'O God of my SALVATION (teshuah)' - God's saving is not a human IB char; the divine deliverance that grounds the tongue's glad singing and praise (279687). Qualifier.
God's righteousness, the theme of the freed tongue's song/praise (v14->v15)

v14 QUALIFIER (God's righteousness): 'my tongue will sing aloud of your RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedaqah)' - God's righteousness is not a human IB char; the divine attribute the pardoned tongue sings, feeding the declared praise (279687). Qualifier.
delight / desire (chaphets - you will not delight in sacrifice)
God's non-delight in mere sacrifice, pointing to the contrite heart he wants (v16->v17)

v16 QUALIFIER (God's desire, negated): 'you will not DELIGHT (chaphets) in sacrifice, or I would give it' - God's (non-)delight is not a human IB char; the divine preference that turns from cultic offering to the broken/contrite heart (279701) as the true sacrifice. Qualifier.
God's non-despising of the contrite heart (v17)

v17 QUALIFIER (God's regard, negated): 'a broken and contrite heart... you will not DESPISE (bazah)' - God's not-scorning is not a human IB char; the divine acceptance that receives the crushed heart (279701) as the sacrifice he seeks. Qualifier.
do good (yatab - do good to Zion)

v18 (cultic/communal coda): 'Do GOOD (yatab) to Zion in your good pleasure; build up the walls of Jerusalem' - God's beneficence toward the city, a communal/institutional petition appended to the individual penitence, with no individual IB char in view. Standalone.
delight (chaphets - then will you delight in right sacrifices)

v19 (cultic coda): 'then will you DELIGHT (chaphets) in right sacrifices' - God's delight in the restored cultus, part of the communal-liturgical ending (once Zion is built, sacrifices please again); no individual IB char. Standalone.

v19 (cultic coda): 'right (tsedeq) sacrifices, in burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings' - the righteous/proper cultic sacrifices of the restored temple; a liturgical object, not an inner operation. Standalone.
